_about: Narration for the Storyraise Connections and sync walkthrough. `text` is what viewers read in captions; [[cue:name]] markers are stripped before TTS and become timestamps visuals land on. `respell` maps a caption word to how the voice should say it (applied to the TTS text only). Labels match the product UI. American English, no em dashes. Value first: caveats (Auto-sync off by default, CRM deletions, OAuth scopes) live in the page FAQ and KB, not here.

scenes.title: Cold open
scenes.text: Your donor data lives in your CRM. [[cue:question]]Your reports should never fall out of step with it. [[cue:brand]]Storyraise Connections keeps the two in sync, in both directions, with Raiser's Edge NXT and Salesforce.

scenes.title: One row per system
scenes.text: [[cue:rows]]Every system you connect gets one row. [[cue:live]]Its status, [[cue:scope]]who it brings across, [[cue:synced]]when it last ran, [[cue:sent]]and what it has sent back.

scenes.title: Connecting
scenes.text: [[cue:connect]]Connecting takes a few minutes. [[cue:signin]]You sign in with Blackbaud or Salesforce and approve access. [[cue:picker]]Then you choose who comes across: a Raiser's Edge list, [[cue:sfpicker]]or one or more Salesforce List Views. [[cue:fields]]From Salesforce you can bring extra fields too, and each one becomes a merge tag for your reports.

scenes.title: Sync frequency
scenes.text: [[cue:menu]]Then turn on Auto-sync. [[cue:frequency]]Storyraise pulls your list again every day, or every Monday if weekly suits you better. [[cue:changes]]New donors, new gifts, and updated details reach your reports without anyone exporting a thing. [[cue:syncnow]]And Sync now runs it on the spot, right before a big send.

scenes.title: Gifts and more
scenes.text: [[cue:adddata]]It is not only names and emails. [[cue:gifts]]Add data brings across Raiser's Edge gifts or Salesforce Opportunities, so each report can thank a donor for their own giving.

scenes.title: Write-back
scenes.text: [[cue:sendback]]And the data flows back. [[cue:engagement]]Storyraise knows who opened their report, how long they read, and what they clicked. [[cue:sendre]]Send to Raiser's Edge writes that onto each constituent's record as a completed action.

scenes.title: One action per donor
scenes.text: [[cue:one]]One action per donor, updated as they read more, so the record never fills up with duplicates. [[cue:fundraiser]]Assign it to the donor's fundraiser, [[cue:threshold]]and send only the donors above the level of engagement you choose.

scenes.title: Salesforce Tasks
scenes.text: [[cue:sf]]In Salesforce, it is one completed Task on each Contact, [[cue:owner]]assigned to their gift officer if you like. [[cue:schedule]]Save it once, and engagement goes back on every scheduled sync.

scenes.title: Close
scenes.text: [[cue:others]]Bloomerang, Virtuous, DonorPerfect, and more connect the same way. [[cue:cta]]Connect your CRM once, and your reports and your records stay in step.
